steps.code:
# Now let me fetch all sent transactions this month. I'll start with the first page.
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction="sent",
        min_created_at=first_day_of_month,
        max_created_at=today,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not page:
        break
    transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total sent transactions this month: {len(transactions)}")
print(transactions)
